info.title: OpenWrt ubus façade
info.description: GENERATED — do not edit. One synthetic REST operation per ubus (object, method), emitted by `ubus-facade` from a real device's `ubus -v list`. Regenerate and diff rather than editing: drift is a red test, not a stale document. Object ids are absent on purpose — they are assigned at registration, do not survive a restart, and are resolved by LOOKUP at call time.

servers.description: Not an HTTP endpoint. ubus is a unix socket at /var/run/ubus/ubus.sock; this base path exists because OpenAPI requires one, and the adapter maps each operation to an INVOKE via x-ubus-object / x-ubus-method.
